title: Not what I expected.
text: Not what I expected.. So sadly from the picture it is not the same. It's very flimsy metal. And the colors are dull it's hard to see in the pictures I shared but it as not as shown. The white on it is almost faded but bright sounds odd but it's the best I can describe it. Almost like the printing was off. Not sure how to describe it but it certainly isn't vibrant I'm certainly glad I didn't pay more for it before and only paid $9.99 but my opinion it should be more like $5 after seeing it in person. I left the plastic it is in on because I'm not sure what I'm going to do with it. I absolutely dislike give less than 5 star reviews it's extremely rare. Im so disappointed.
